## Change

Describe the problem, intended player behavior, and resulting change.

Link the assigned issue, milestone, GDD version/sections and relevant acceptance scenario IDs. State which scenarios this patch completes and which remain later integration obligations.

## Validation

List checks performed and results, including interaction checks where applicable.

Include inventory/personnel reconciliation and readable blocking-state evidence when relevant. A headless startup check does not prove visual or gameplay correctness.

## Design and risks

Record material assumptions, performance implications, and remaining limitations. Omit if none.
